fixed_A28.scope: CPU arithmetic of existing registered A28 velocity predictions, four TRAIN tasks and two teachers each; no new model/native/environment execution or labels. Full minus public is a functional difference on matched original query/noise/tau, not a parameter attribution.

captured_head_features.scope: CPU arithmetic of already captured TRAIN X/H/c/d and the corresponding saved head matrices, Q8/V8/action_out only. native_action_readback.scope: CPU affine action_out readback of eight preregistered TRAIN teacher captures for C12/D71; same eight teacher action labels as prior900 analysis. Crossed H/output matrices are an exact frozen output-layer decomposition, not policy or compiler interventions. Fixed probe/tau1 velocities are not ten-step actions.

T/U、合法正确/近邻/远视频函数差与成熟T闭环正例，支持教学—执行共同坐标是有用学习偏置。绑定不自动赋予对象、关系或阶段语义，也未使teacher X与query hidden同分布。
